Method of Attack: Phishing campaign using fake shipping delivery lures
Macro code in attached document fetches STRRAT malware
Malware decrypts configuration file, copies itself, adds Windows registry entries for persistence
Steals passwords from web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Microsoft Edge)
Steals passwords from email clients (Outlook, Thunderbird, Foxmail)
Runs pseudo-ransomware module to simulate infection without encrypting files
Noisy C2 communication over ports 1780 and 1788 at one-second intervals
Attack Vector: Phishing emails impersonating Maersk Shipping with Excel attachments or ZIP files containing STRRAT
Direct delivery via ZIP files without intermediate droppers
